title: ConstraintSpec
description: Hard constraints (plus optional soft preferences) for one TravelPlanner query. An LLM emits this from the natural-language query alone; the solver combines it with the query's reference_information to produce plans.

origin.description: Departure city, plain name as in the TravelPlanner city set, e.g. "Washington".

type.description: "city" for a single-city trip (3 days), "state" when the query names a destination state to tour (5 or 7 days).

name.description: City name (e.g. "Myrtle Beach") or US state name (e.g. "Texas").

days.description: Total trip length in days, including departure and return days.

startDate.description: First day of the trip, YYYY-MM-DD.

visitingCityNumber.description: Number of distinct cities visited besides the origin.

budget.description: Total trip budget in USD, covering transportation, meals and accommodation.

houseRule.description: If set, the chosen accommodations must ALLOW this (i.e. their house_rules must not forbid it).

roomType.description: Required room type of every chosen accommodation.

cuisines.description: Cuisines that must each appear in at least one meal outside the origin city.

transportation.description: Transportation mode restriction applying to the whole trip.

soft.description: Soft preferences: only influence candidate ranking, never feasibility.
